summary: One pull request in packages/envoy/internal/dispatch. pmdoc.FindMarks finds every wanted mark in one walk; refreshAnchors and ReplaceText's per-row FindMark+MarkAttrs loop use it. ReplaceText's re-anchors reuse one quote finder and one Y text-range table and skip nearestBlocks on discarded misses. MarkQuote drops its treeOf re-read and reads the anchor from applyLive's write.tree. yTextRanges computes ranges in its one traversal. Equivalence tests against unchanged FindMark, a frozen yTextRanges and per-call re-anchoring (bytes-equal CRDT state), on corpus, generated real-size documents and real LINUX specs via PMDOC_ANCHOR_CORPUS. Benchmarks at 10/40/80 anchors with a ratio pass line. The merge rule runs on the architect's replay (tools/load.py, F=0.3) until INFRA-639's lands.

tasks.work: Add FindMarks(doc, []MarkRef) map[MarkRef]MarkFound{Range, Quote, Attrs}: one walk, per-key state machine unseen->open->closed; O(marks on run + open keys) per run; quote and attrs exactly as FindMark/MarkAttrs (separator rule, leaf nodes, empty runs held until the span grows past them, nulAsReplacement, type+id matching, non-string ids never match). Zero keys: no walk. FindMark and MarkSpans unchanged.
refreshAnchors: key list once (skip by MarkID across types), one FindMarks, loop over rows in order looking each up; rows sharing a key each updated with their own event; no rows -> no walk.

ReplaceText: one FindMarks on current (remove the unreachable 'missing attributes' branch); QuoteFinder built lazily at the first re-anchor and reused (FindQuote becomes its one-shot use); miss mode that skips nearestBlocks but still errors.Is ErrTargetNotFound; normalized runes cached in textForms; mark writer that computes yTextRanges once lazily after MarkRange's per-call checks and reuses it; same Format calls in the same order. If AC3's upload line fails, a single-pass exact search for all re-anchor quotes.

MarkQuote: callback does startTree + markQuoteInTxn only; after applyLive returns nil, readAnchored(joinedLiveWrite(ctx, artifactID).tree, ...); ErrAnchorMissing -> the same ErrDocSchema 'written mark %q is missing' error.

yTextRanges computes each Y text's ProseMirror range during its one traversal (no Node shape, no walk), every refusal and its order unchanged; frozen copy of today's implementation kept in the test as oracle.
